meta.title: Khmer Phrases and Expressions
meta.subtitle: 860 phrases and sentences · 35 phrases, 825 sentences · both directions
meta.desc: Khmer said whole: greetings, the phrasebook questions a visitor needs, wishes, signs, a few exclamations, a proverb, and a large set of short everyday sentences. Both study directions, each a card of its own: Khmer → English and English → Khmer. 35 PHRASES are the phrases, set greetings and proverbs English Wiktionary has for Khmer that the level decks do not teach, with Wiktionary's own meaning and romanisation: អរុណសួស្តី 'good morning' and រាត្រីសួស្ដី 'good night', ស្វាគមន៍ 'welcome', គ្មានបញ្ហា 'no problem', តើអ្នកនិយាយភាសាអង់គ្លេសទេ? 'do you speak English?', ថ្លៃទេ? 'how much does it cost?', រីករាយថ្ងៃខួបកំណើត 'happy birthday', ហាមជក់បារី 'no smoking', and the proverb ចាបមួយនៅដៃប្រសើរក្រៃ ជាងចាបដប់នៅលើឈើ, 'a bird in the hand is worth two in the bush'. 825 SENTENCES are Tatoeba's short Khmer sentences (eight words at most) with their English translation, printed as Tatoeba has them, each card giving the sentence's Tatoeba number so it can be traced to its author; where two Khmer sentences share an English one, only the first is a card, so every English side has one answer. They carry no romanisation (Tatoeba gives none): the Khmer Alphabet deck teaches the script, and the level decks the words. THE PHRASES ARE FEW BECAUSE THE SOURCE IS: Wiktionary files about forty Khmer entries as phrases and none as idioms, so nothing here is invented and the deck is not padded. It is not a CEFR level, and nothing the level decks teach is repeated. There is no speaker button: few devices have a Khmer voice. Sources: English Wiktionary, via the kaikki.org extraction and the entries' pages (CC BY-SA 4.0); Tatoeba (tatoeba.org), CC BY 2.0 FR.
